lines.text: Jesus goes to the Mount of Olives, kneels a stone's throw from the disciples, and prays for the Father's will.
An angel from heaven strengthens Jesus, and afterward He finds the disciples asleep, exhausted from travel.
A crowd led by Judas arrives, and Jesus asks if he is betraying the Son of Man with a kiss.
One disciple strikes the high priest's servant, cutting off his left ear, and Jesus touches the ear and heals him.
Jesus asks the crowd why they came with swords and clubs as against an outlaw, and says this hour belongs to the power of darkness.
